title: Third-strand DNA manuscript blocked
summary: Dave Rossi tells of Third-strand DNA manuscript blocked, about c. 2022 at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the evidence of in which um I wrote up a manuscript dealing with the third strand of DNA. This is a two or three years ago and they were willing to help me put it in uh peer-reviewed format to help it be reviewed in the more international literature. Unfortunately, that individual was restrained uh from being able to help me

plain: A man named Dave Rossi, a guest on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in an episode about aliens teaching him advanced physics, says that two or three years earlier, around 2022, he wrote a manuscript about a "third strand" of DNA, meaning a strand beyond the usual two. He says someone was willing to help him get it into peer-reviewed form, the format where other scientists check work before it is published, but that this person was then "restrained" from helping. If true, it would suggest someone was quietly blocking his ideas from reaching scientists abroad.
